notes.content:

Great News, the Aquapark Tycoon Demo is now officially out! You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089380/Aquapark_Tycoon_Demo/]get it here[/url] or on the Aquapark Tycoon Store Page!

Have Fun!

notes.title: Dev Diary #3: Saunas in Aquapark Tycoon
notes.content:
In our third Dev Diary, we’re taking you behind the scenes of Aquapark Tycoon to share an exclusive glimpse into the development of our upcoming water park simulation.
In Aquapark Tycoon, you can design the water park of your dreams: from pools, which we explored in the first Dev Diaries, to thrilling water slides and saunas where your guests can unwind and recharge.
But now, grab your sauna towel, dear water park fans, because things are about to heat up! In today’s developer diary, we’re diving deep into the steamy world of saunas!

[b]Sauna Types at a Glance[/b]
When we started developing Aquapark Tycoon, one thing was especially important to us: players should have the freedom to design their water park exactly how they want! You’re in control of every little detail. That means: You can customize the sauna layout, tweak the temperature and humidity, decide on seating and lounging areas, and pick the perfect decoration items like classic sauna buckets, dried herbs, sand timers, or stylish lamps and columns. You can choose the infusions and create your own schedule with different scents. And if you’re feeling extra creative, you can add music and light effects to turn a sauna visit into an unforgettable experience for your guests.
To make sure you get the most authentic options, our devs went on a “sweat tour” across Germany. We visited countless saunas – and, yeah, we took a few deep sniffs – to make sure everything in the game feels just right.
We’d like to introduce the following first four sauna types to you:

[b]Finnish Sauna[/b]
This is the classic sauna experience. A powerful stove ensures your guests work up a sweat at temperatures between 70 and 95°C, while the humidity stays at a comfortable 5 to 30%. After the heat, cooling down is essential – perfect for getting the blood circulation going.
But be careful! Crank up the heat too much, and your guests won’t just turn red – they’ll bolt out of the sauna faster than you’d like. So, keep an eye on the intensity rating to make sure the sauna session is relaxing and not a reason to call for help!
[list]
[*] Temperature: 70 - 95°C
[*] Humidity: 5 - 30%
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/83913827a39ab11778c97208adc5d63a83486cdf.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam Bath[/b]
The name says it all: with humidity levels at a whopping 90 to 100%, thanks to constant steam, the room is filled with a thick mist. The steam is great for your guests, helping to boost metabolism and relax muscles. And the best part? The temperature stays mild, between 45 and 55°C.
[list]
[*] Temperature: 45 - 55°C
[*] Humidity: 90 - 100%
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/be3795718645635a1cb6ce27e2cb4ca753ccc94f.jpg[/img]

[b]Salt Sauna[/b]
In the salt sauna, your guests can enjoy a mini seaside getaway – without ever leaving your park. What a fantastic service! With walls made of salt stone, you infuse the air with a refreshing, salty breeze that’s great for the respiratory system.
With temperatures between 55 and 80°C and humidity levels around 15 to 20%, most visitors find it incredibly soothing.
[list]
[*] Temperature: 55 - 80°C
[*] Humidity: 15 - 20%
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/af88f023b60facaa7e3a8e558d558324d0c77ba7.jpg[/img]

[b]Event Sauna[/b]
For those who want something a bit more extraordinary, the event sauna is the perfect choice. With temperatures between 50 and 100°C and humidity up to 30%, you can create unforgettable moments. Show-infusions at the event sauna stove, paired with impressive music and light effects, turn every visit into a spectacular experience.
[list]
[*] Temperature: 50 - 100°C
[*] Humidity: 1 - 30%
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/df1969ad4191bf6498a13e3b4d81eadd8f5347eb.jpg[/img]


That’s enough sweating for today! We hope you’ll have just as much fun building and customizing your saunas as we did. By the way: We are currently looking for [b]playtesters[/b]. If you're interested in testing Aquapark Tycoon for us, make sure you head right over to our [url=https://discord.gg/aquaparktycoon]Discord [/url]for more info on how to sign up!🐙

notes.title: Dev Diary #2: Dive into Aquapark Tycoon – An Overview of Pool Types
notes.content:
Hello, water park fans!
 
In our first Dev Diary, we explored how you can build pools in Aquapark Tycoon. Today, we’re shifting our focus to the different types of pools you can create. We’ll guide you on transforming a basic pool into one of the exciting variations featured below. Let’s dive in!

Once you’ve set up your basic pool, you can customize its type by adjusting factors such as water temperature, water type, depth, and equipment. Beyond the standard swimmer’s pool, you’ll have the following exciting options:

[b]Sports Pool[/b]
This pool is perfect for those who prioritize swimming technique and speed! A sports pool should typically be long, around 2.5 meters deep, and filled with cool, refreshing water. Adding swim lines ensures proper lane separation, allowing your sports enthusiasts to train without interruptions.
Starting blocks are essential for encouraging guests to take daring dives into the cool water. To add even more excitement, equip the sports pool with various sports equipment to make all the fitness fans among your guests truly happy.
[list]
[*] Cool water 
[*] Up to 2.5 meters deep 
[*] Extras: swim lines, starting blocks and sports equipment
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/298ba548c5cad9958bef8ace771090f982b1b2a8.jpg[/img]

[b]Fun Pool[/b]
The fun pool is all about making a splash! It’s the perfect spot for water enthusiasts of all ages to play and have a great time. Equip it with exciting features like inflatable flamingos, small slides, and playful water fountains to create a pool full of entertainment and joy.
You can design the fun pool as either a non-swimmer or swimmer’s pool, making it enjoyable for visitors of all ages.
[list]
[*] Cool water
[*] Moderate depth
[*] Extras: small slides, water play structures
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/8fd5ef6cf5f96f98b8e45b4f41ed0877566f7e32.jpg[/img]

[b]Thermal Pool[/b]
The thermal pool offers the ultimate retreat for guests seeking relaxation. With warm, mineral-enriched water maintained at a soothing 35 °C, it’s the perfect spot to melt away stress. The pool’s depth can be adjusted to allow adults to stand comfortably, enhancing overall comfort.
For an added touch of luxury, equip the thermal pool with massage jets and hydrotherapy fountains to provide your guests with a truly memorable experience. This is where they can fully unwind and relax.
[list]
[*] Warm water enriched with minerals
[*] Moderate depth
[*] Extras: hydrotherapy fountains, massage jets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/b00c76f380e61d4bfde7c036bc08e11b8d217527.jpg[/img]

[b]Whirlpool[/b]
Not only in the thermal pool but also in the whirlpool, water enthusiasts can fully relax and unwind. The warm, bubbling water provides an unmatched feel-good experience. Whirlpools can be designed as standalone pools with comfortable seating or integrated flexibly into the aqua park as placeable Jacuzzis.
This flexibility allows you to create relaxation zones exactly where your guests need them most.
[list]
[*] Warm, bubbling water
[*] Moderate depth
[*] Extras: Massage jets, comfortable seating options
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/b0df7a1f88e7996b7d83b1f9e3f06e0a55c17b57.jpg[/img]

[b]Wave Pool[/b]
The wave pool is the ultimate destination for thrill-seekers and adventure lovers! With its gradual, sloping entry and a powerful wave machine, guests can experience the excitement of rolling waves as if they were at the ocean. Bring the sounds and sensations of the sea directly into your water park and let visitors dive into the action.
[list]
[*] Moderately warm water
[*] Shallow entry with steadily increasing depth
[*] Extras: wave machine
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/7a948c1c6ab2757da18ffdef1e15ad4fec8ea7b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Children's Pool[/b]
Don’t forget about the youngest guests – many families will visit your water park! The children's pool is specifically designed for little water lovers, featuring shallow water and plenty of colourful water play structures. It strikes the perfect balance between safety and fun, offering a carefree environment for splashing, playing, and exploring.
[list]
[*] Warm water
[*] Shallow depth
[*] Extras: water play structures
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/fc182aa895152fe3ca7d1d651be185964d9e72bb.jpg[/img]


We hope you enjoyed this dive into the world of cool waters. Let us know in the comments which pool is your favourite! 🐙

notes.title: Dev Diary #1: Building and Splashing Around in Aquapark Tycoon & Brand-New Look
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/d80faa3308835af21effa602785f2f6a60099ae5.gif[/img]

Attention, water park enthusiasts! Today marks the start of our Dev Diary for Aquapark Tycoon! We’ll take you behind the scenes and share exciting game development insights on a regular basis.

Let’s dive into the heart of every water park: [b]pools[/b]!

Before we dive into that, we’ve got something exciting to share: the all-new look of Aquapark Tycoon! Over the past few months, we’ve been hard at work refining the game’s visual style. With this fresh design, we’re bringing a more immersive, lifelike atmosphere to your colorful water park.

One of our main focuses was the color palette: gone are the overly bright hues. Instead, Aquapark Tycoon now shines in natural tones. Trees, plants, and grass have a more authentic, vibrant feel. We hope the new look makes you fall in love with your parks all over again! 🌴

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963961/1e2ddb2ac03a211291a5bf71f3a8134ba3010ba3.png[/img]

Now, we’re making a splash with a closer look at how you can create pools in Aquapark Tycoon. Pools are the centerpiece of every water park, and we’ve ensured a wide range of pool types and customization options. From shallow children pools to wave pools, you’ll have everything you need to delight guests of all ages.

So grab your pencils, jot down some ideas, and let’s dive into the art of pool building together!

[h3]The Art of Pool Building[/h3]

In Aquapark Tycoon, guests have diverse preferences when it comes to pools. While some enjoy swimming laps in a sports pool, others are drawn to the thrill of wave pools or the fun of splash zones. Now, we’re excited to explore the construction feature in Aquapark Tycoon, which allows you to transform even the simplest pool into something extraordinary.

Here’s how it works:

You’ll begin with a basic square pool shape. If your budget allows, you can expand its length and width for a larger pool or keep it compact if resources are tight. Even this basic shape can be upgraded into something special, like a sports or wave pool.

For the more creative builders, the sky’s the limit! You can experiment with rounded corners or mix circular and square shapes to design the wildest layouts. The key is that every new addition must connect to your basic pool. Let your imagination flow – your creations could look something like this:

[previewyoutube=yss3x1oswyc;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to make a splash with your unique pool designs! In Aquapark Tycoon, you have the freedom to design your water park exactly the way you want it. Whether you’re recreating a real-world park or building a completely unique aquatic adventure, the possibilities are endless.

Customization begins with pool construction and extends to choosing equipment and shape, and even setting the depth of individual pools. This flexibility allows you to create safe, shallow areas for non-swimmers while offering deeper sections for experienced swimmers to enjoy.

Your park’s success (and your profits!) depends on how well you fulfill your guests’ diverse needs: Sports pools for fitness fans, fun pools with thrilling attractions for the adventurous, wellness pools for those seeking relaxation.

Your goal is to bring all these elements together into a water park that delights every visitor. 

[previewyoutube=hchoIhm-M-s;full][/previewyoutube]

In our next Dev Diary, we’ll check out how you can adapt pools to suit the various needs of your guests and reveal the exciting pool types you can look forward to in the game!

We’d love to hear from you: What features or options would you like to see for pool construction in Aquapark Tycoon? Let us know in the comments! 🐙
